prior_surface_observation.interpretation: Additional post-stop provider attempts were recorded after the already-persisted runtime-drift observation.

external_primary_reference.source: GitHub Docs / self-hosted runner routing precedence
external_primary_reference.relevant_rule: A job remains queued when GitHub cannot find an online and idle self-hosted runner matching the required labels/groups; matching jobs may be assigned later when a runner becomes available.

analysis.why: OpenRouter request telemetry increased by another 180 after the prior post-stop observation, with success unchanged. The emergency stop therefore has not produced observed provider-attempt quiescence at this snapshot.
analysis.why_runner: Both the Trigger-2 job and the older self-hosted probe remain queued with runner_id=0 and empty runner_name. This is compatible with no currently eligible online idle matching runner, but repository-level evidence cannot distinguish offline runner, label mismatch, access/group policy, or scheduling-service causes.
analysis.deferred_execution_hazard: The queued Trigger-2 run is latent execution debt: because it remains queued rather than cancelled, it can become executable later if an eligible runner appears. Its workflow snapshot uses an older fixed CLAY_SHA and therefore must not be treated as current-source acceptance even if it later runs.
analysis.push_fanout: No additional controller push was issued in this recheck. Historical controller push fanout remains a coordination hazard; this recheck does not create another fanout event.

hypotheses.claim: A pre-stop or independently supervised OpenRouter-capable process continues attempting requests despite source-level admission shutdown.
hypotheses.support: Post-stop request and 429 counters continue increasing while success remains fixed.

hypotheses.claim: The apparent counter growth is delayed/replayed metrics publication rather than new live provider attempts.
hypotheses.support: Metrics are emitted by a separate publisher and repository telemetry alone does not expose the responsible live PID.
hypotheses.falsifier: Live host process/socket evidence plus bounded no-restart interval showing zero new provider attempts, or proof that last_observed_at is generated from delayed historical events rather than request time.

hypotheses.claim: No eligible online idle self-hosted runner currently matches the queued jobs.
hypotheses.support: Persistent queued state with runner_id=0 and empty runner_name across two independent self-hosted jobs.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A runner may be healthy but blocked by label/group/repository access or scheduling policy.

next_exact_actions: Use the existing owner-authorized live-host quiescence bridge to identify exact PID/PPID/ARGV and network/socket ownership for any OpenRouter-capable process; stop/disable only the responsible FreeSwarm/provider-capable process tree and persist before/after process evidence.
Observe a bounded no-restart interval with zero provider-usage delta before reopening any execution gate.
Inspect self-hosted runner service status and effective labels/group/repository access without another controller push. Do not infer runner health from queue state alone.

Cancel or supersede stale queued Trigger-2 execution before restoring runner liveness if an available control surface permits, then re-enter current supervisor authority and dispatch at most one current-SHA deduplicated workflow_dispatch run only after quiescence PASS.
research_delta: This recheck upgrades the FreeSwarm emergency-stop frontier from merely unproven quiescence to direct current negative evidence at the observed metrics snapshot, and identifies the still-queued unassigned Trigger-2 job as deferred stale-execution risk.
